title: Plagues & Pleasures on the Salton Sea | KQED Truly CA
summary: A KQED Truly CA documentary narrated by John Waters about the Salton Sea, a once-glamorous California vacation spot now home to an eccentric community. It covers the area's economic, political and environmental problems and features Salvation Mountain.
why: HN recommends it as an engaging, funny and fascinating documentary, and cites it in threads on the Salton Sea's history and environmental decline.

quote.text: Definitely one of my top 10 documentaries
